limitations: Static optical wetness/water; no rainfall, infiltration, runoff, conserved water inventory, gameplay collision or authoritative terrain change.
Closure is guaranteed only on sampled piecewise-linear patches; sub-grid drains and exact asynchronous CBT intersection remain outside that guarantee.
Opaque turbid-water approximation; no refraction, depth transmission, multiple scattering or guaranteed nearby vegetation reflection. Showcase uses existing whole-partition RT fallback.
Moss morphology, optical retention, wet roughness and water bottom colour are authored priors, not measured hydrology or biology.
Baseline images/timings retained from the exact 851572f build earlier the same day. Runs are serial offscreen, not counterbalanced or equal-workload speedup evidence.
New cover geometry changes immutable mesh publication cost; moving-window rebuild stalls remain possible.
One Radeon 880M/Vulkan platform; no remote CI, independent aesthetic votes, reference parity or general temporal acceptance. Moving endpoint is diagnostic only.
Implementer inspection: added puddles read as small dark mid-ground spots. Their visual contribution remains modest, especially beneath dense plants; wet-ground reference composition is not reached.
The moving endpoint visibly loses fine soil detail during asynchronous residency changes. Its 722.897 ms GPU median is diagnostic; temporal quality and interactive performance are not accepted.
